description: Bug 2: Move <Icon> out of Button children into leadingIcon/trailingIcon props, or convert icon-only Buttons to IconButton. 13 files affected. The new Button API puts icon-slot sizing and gap CSS on the leadingIcon/trailingIcon props, not on children. Independent from FEAT-001 and FEAT-003.
steps: Read context.json at /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/.agents/tasks/task-mui-v2-regression/context.json and this FEAT file before touching any source. FEAT-001 must already be committed.

Rules: (a) Icon before label text → leadingIcon={<Icon name='...' />}. (b) Icon after label text → trailingIcon={<Icon name='...' />}. (c) Icon-only button (no text child at all) → <IconButton icon={<Icon name='...' />} .../>. (d) Drop size={N} from Icon when it goes into leadingIcon or trailingIcon — the button slot controls icon sizing. (e) Children must be text-only after the change.
